sources: Golden Age (6-star polearm; fits an Electric healer such as Liino). Skill 3 sk_wpn_lance_0016 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; SkillPatchTable L1–L9 pulse_dmg_up 0.06–0.168, heal_up 0.04–0.112 for duration 15 s, spell_dmg_up 0.05–0.14 for duration2 20 s): cardAttributeModifier attribute 52 (Electric DMG) +pulse_dmg_up is a stat-panel line, as are skills 1–2 (Will, Treatment Efficiency).

abilityEvent 302 (OnBeforeOutputDamage) + CheckOriginSkillType [6] (the wielder's combo deals damage) → buff_wpn_lance_0016_heal on the wielder: Treatment Efficiency (attribute 29) +heal_up for duration. Heal amounts aren't modelled, so the buff has no damage modifier; it's kept for its events and the timeline.

abilityEvent 50 (OnOutputHeal) + CheckHealTag combo (−1517158118) + NotNext CheckTargetsEqual (the healed operator isn't the wielder) → buff_wpn_lance_0016_dmgup on the team (CharacterTeamFinder): Arts DMG (attributes 51–54 formulaItem 5) +spell_dmg_up for duration2; stackingType 1 with priority key spell_dmg_up (the stack group from gameBuff: two wielders' copies don't add). The wielder's own heals only (50, not 45 OnReceiveHeal). On Camille it never fires (her combo heals herself); on Liino her combo's heal of the controlled operator does when that's someone else.
